verses.original: וְזֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הָאָשָׁ֑ם קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zōṯ tō·w·raṯ hā·’ā·šām qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm hū
verses.literal: Now this is the law of the guilt offering which is most holy
verses.literalPt: Esta é a lei da oferta pela culpa: coisa santíssima é.

verses.original: בִּמְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁחֲטוּ֙ אֶת־ הָ֣עֹלָ֔ה יִשְׁחֲט֖וּ אֶת־ הָאָשָׁ֑ם וְאֶת־ דָּמ֛וֹ יִזְרֹ֥ק עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: bim·qō·wm ’ă·šer yiš·ḥă·ṭū ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·lāh yiš·ḥă·ṭū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·šām wə·’eṯ- dā·mōw yiz·rōq ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: The guilt offering must be slaughtered in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered and the priest shall splatter its blood on all sides of the altar
verses.literalPt: A oferta pela culpa será morta no lugar em que é morto o holocausto; e o sangue da oferta se aspergirá sobre o altar ao redor.

verses.original: וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־ חֶלְבּ֖וֹ יַקְרִ֣יב מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֵ֚ת הָֽאַלְיָ֔ה וְאֶת־ הַחֵ֖לֶב הַֽמְכַסֶּ֥ה אֶת־ הַקֶּֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ kāl- ḥel·bōw yaq·rîḇ mim·men·nū ’êṯ hā·’al·yāh wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥê·leḇ ham·ḵas·seh ’eṯ- haq·qe·reḇ
verses.literal: And all the fat from it shall be offered the fat tail the fat that covers the entrails
verses.literalPt: Dela se oferecerá toda a gordura. A cauda gorda, a gordura que cobre os intestinos,

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־ הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת־ הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־ הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל־ הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ šə·tê hak·kə·lā·yōṯ wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥê·leḇ ’ă·šer ‘ă·lê·hen ’ă·šer ‘al- hak·kə·sā·lîm wə·’eṯ- hay·yō·ṯe·reṯ ‘al- hak·kā·ḇêḏ ‘al- hak·kə·lā·yōṯ yə·sî·ren·nāh
verses.literal: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins and the lobe of the liver which is to be removed with the kidneys
verses.literalPt: os dois rins, a gordura que está sobre eles e a que está junto aos lombos e o redenho sobre o fígado, juntamente com os rins os tirará.

verses.original: וְהִקְטִ֨יר אֹתָ֤ם הַכֹּהֵן֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה אָשָׁ֖ם הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·ṭîr ’ō·ṯām hak·kō·hên ham·miz·bê·ḥāh ’iš·šeh Yah·weh ’ā·šām hū
verses.literal: The priest shall burn them on the altar as a food offering to the LORD it is a guilt offering
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote os queimará sobre o altar como oferta queimada a Jeová; é uma oferta pela culpa.

verses.original: כָּל־ זָכָ֥ר בַּכֹּהֲנִ֖ים יֹאכְלֶ֑נּוּ בְּמָק֤וֹם קָדוֹשׁ֙ יֵאָכֵ֔ל קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- zā·ḵār bak·kō·hă·nîm yō·ḵə·len·nū bə·mā·qō·wm qā·ḏō·wōš yê·’ā·ḵêl qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm hū
verses.literal: Every male among the priests may eat of it It must be eaten in a holy place it is most holy
verses.literalPt: Todo homem entre os sacerdotes comerá dela; comer-se-á num lugar santo; coisa santíssima é.

verses.original: כַּֽחַטָּאת֙ כָּֽאָשָׁ֔ם תּוֹרָ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לָהֶ֑ם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְכַפֶּר־ בּ֖וֹ ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ka·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ kā·’ā·šām tō·w·rāh ’a·ḥaṯ lā·hem hak·kō·hên ’ă·šer yə·ḵap·per- bōw lōw yih·yeh
verses.literal: The guilt offering is like the sin offering the same law applies to both It belongs to the priest who makes atonement with it
verses.literalPt: Como é a oferta pelo pecado, assim será a oferta pela culpa: há uma só lei para elas; pertencerá ao sacerdote que com ela fizer expiação.

verses.original: וְהַ֨כֹּהֵ֔ן הַמַּקְרִ֖יב אֶת־ עֹ֣לַת אִ֑ישׁ ע֤וֹר הָֽעֹלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְרִ֔יב לַכֹּהֵ֖ן ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hak·kō·hên ham·maq·rîḇ ’eṯ- ‘ō·laṯ ’îš ‘ō·wr hā·‘ō·lāh ’ă·šer hiq·rîḇ lak·kō·hên lōw yih·yeh
verses.literal: As for the priest who presents a burnt offering for anyone the hide of that offering - . . . belongs to him . . .
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote que oferecer o holocausto de alguém, terá para si o couro do holocausto que tiver oferecido.

verses.original: וְכָל־ מִנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תֵּֽאָפֶה֙ בַּתַּנּ֔וּר וְכָל־ נַעֲשָׂ֥ה בַמַּרְחֶ֖שֶׁת וְעַֽל־ מַחֲבַ֑ת לַכֹּהֵ֛ן הַמַּקְרִ֥יב אֹתָ֖הּ ל֥וֹ תִֽהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl min·ḥāh ’ă·šer tê·’ā·p̄eh bat·tan·nūr wə·ḵāl na·‘ă·śāh ḇam·mar·ḥe·šeṯ wə·‘al- ma·ḥă·ḇaṯ lak·kō·hên ham·maq·rîḇ ’ō·ṯāh lōw ṯih·yeh
verses.literal: Likewise , every grain offering that is baked in an oven . . . or cooked in a pan or on a griddle belongs to the priest who presents it
verses.literalPt: Toda oferta de cereais que se assar no forno, e tudo o que se preparar na frigideira e na assadeira, pertencerá ao sacerdote que a oferecer.

verses.original: וְכָל־ מִנְחָ֥ה בְלוּלָֽה־ בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן וַחֲרֵבָ֑ה לְכָל־ בְּנֵ֧י אַהֲרֹ֛ן תִּהְיֶ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ כְּאָחִֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl min·ḥāh ḇə·lū·lāh- ḇaš·še·men wa·ḥă·rê·ḇāh lə·ḵāl bə·nê ’a·hă·rōn tih·yeh ’îš kə·’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: and every grain offering whether dry or mixed with oil belongs equally . . . to all the sons of Aaron
verses.literalPt: Toda oferta de cereais, ou seja ela amassada com azeite, ou seja enxuta, pertencerá a todos os filhos de Arão, tanto a um como a outro.

verses.original: וְזֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַקְרִ֖יב לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zōṯ tō·w·raṯ ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm ’ă·šer yaq·rîḇ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now this is the law of the peace offering that one may present to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Esta é a lei do sacrifício das ofertas pacíficas, que alguém oferecer a Jeová.

verses.original: אִ֣ם עַל־ תּוֹדָה֮ יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ֒ וְהִקְרִ֣יב׀ עַל־ זֶ֣בַח הַתּוֹדָ֗ה חַלּ֤וֹת מַצּוֹת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֣ים בַּשָּׁ֑מֶן וְסֹ֣לֶת מֻרְבֶּ֔כֶת חַלֹּ֖ת בְּלוּלֹ֥ת בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: ’im ‘al- tō·w·ḏāh yaq·rî·ḇen·nū wə·hiq·rîḇ ‘al- ze·ḇaḥ hat·tō·w·ḏāh ḥal·lō·wṯ maṣ·ṣō·wṯ bə·lū·lōṯ baš·še·men ū·rə·qî·qê maṣ·ṣō·wṯ mə·šu·ḥîm baš·šā·men wə·sō·leṯ mur·be·ḵeṯ ḥal·lōṯ bə·lū·lōṯ baš·šā·men
verses.literal: If he offers it in thanksgiving then along with the sacrifice of thanksgiving he shall offer unleavened cakes mixed with olive oil unleavened wafers coated with oil and well-kneaded cakes of fine flour mixed with oil
verses.literalPt: Se o oferecer por ação de graças, com o sacrifício da ação de graças oferecerá bolos asmos amassados com azeite e obreias asmas untadas com azeite, de flor de farinha embebida em azeite, em forma de bolos amassados com azeite.

verses.original: עַל־ חַלֹּת֙ לֶ֣חֶם חָמֵ֔ץ יַקְרִ֖יב קָרְבָּנ֑וֹ עַל־ זֶ֖בַח תּוֹדַ֥ת שְׁלָמָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- ḥal·lōṯ le·ḥem ḥā·mêṣ yaq·rîḇ qā·rə·bā·nōw ‘al- ze·ḇaḥ tō·w·ḏaṯ šə·lā·māw
verses.literal: Along with his peace offering of thanksgiving he is to present an offering with cakes of leavened bread
verses.literalPt: De bolos de pão levedado oferecerá a sua oblação com o sacrifício das suas ofertas pacíficas por ação de graças.

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֨יב מִמֶּ֤נּוּ אֶחָד֙ מִכָּל־ קָרְבָּ֔ן תְּרוּמָ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה לַכֹּהֵ֗ן הַזֹּרֵ֛ק אֶת־ דַּ֥ם הַשְּׁלָמִ֖ים ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·rîḇ mim·men·nū ’e·ḥāḏ mik·kāl qār·bān tə·rū·māh Yah·weh lak·kō·hên haz·zō·rêq ’eṯ- dam haš·šə·lā·mîm lōw yih·yeh
verses.literal: From the cakes he must present one portion of each offering as a contribution to the LORD It belongs to the priest who sprinkles the blood of the peace offering
verses.literalPt: Dele oferecerá uma de cada oblação por oferta alçada a Jeová; e essa pertencerá ao sacerdote que aspergir o sangue das ofertas pacíficas.

verses.original: וּבְשַׂ֗ר זֶ֚בַח תּוֹדַ֣ת שְׁלָמָ֔יו בְּי֥וֹם קָרְבָּנ֖וֹ יֵאָכֵ֑ל לֹֽא־ יַנִּ֥יחַ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד־ בֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·śar ze·ḇaḥ tō·w·ḏaṯ šə·lā·māw bə·yō·wm qā·rə·bā·nōw yê·’ā·ḵêl lō- yan·nî·aḥ mim·men·nū ‘aḏ- bō·qer
verses.literal: The meat of the sacrifice of his peace offering of thanksgiving must be eaten on the day he offers it none of it may be left until morning
verses.literalPt: A carne do sacrifício das suas ofertas pacíficas por ação de graças comer-se-á no dia da sua oblação; nada dela se deixará até pela manhã.

verses.original: וְאִם־ נֶ֣דֶר׀ א֣וֹ נְדָבָ֗ה זֶ֚בַח קָרְבָּנ֔וֹ בְּי֛וֹם הַקְרִיב֥וֹ אֶת־ זִבְח֖וֹ יֵאָכֵ֑ל וּמִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וְהַנּוֹתָ֥ר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ יֵאָכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ne·ḏer ’ōw nə·ḏā·ḇāh ze·ḇaḥ qā·rə·bā·nōw bə·yō·wm haq·rî·ḇōw ’eṯ- ziḇ·ḥōw yê·’ā·ḵêl ū·mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ wə·han·nō·w·ṯār mim·men·nū yê·’ā·ḵêl
verses.literal: If, however the sacrifice he offers is a vow or a freewill offering it shall be eaten on the day he presents his sacrifice but the remainder may be eaten on the next day
verses.literalPt: Mas, se o sacrifício da sua oblação for um voto, ou uma oferta voluntária, comer-se-á no dia em que oferecer o seu sacrifício, e no dia seguinte se comerá o que dele ficar;

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתָ֖ר מִבְּשַׂ֣ר הַזָּ֑בַח בַּיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nō·w·ṯār mib·bə·śar haz·zā·ḇaḥ bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî bā·’êš yiś·śā·rêp̄
verses.literal: But any meat of the sacrifice remaining until the third day must be burned up
verses.literalPt: porém queimar-se-á com o fogo o que ficar da carne do sacrifício ao terceiro dia.

verses.original: וְאִ֣ם הֵאָכֹ֣ל יֵ֠אָכֵל מִבְּשַׂר־ זֶ֨בַח שְׁלָמָ֜יו בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֮ לֹ֣א יֵרָצֶה֒ הַמַּקְרִ֣יב אֹת֗וֹ לֹ֧א יֵחָשֵׁ֛ב ל֖וֹ פִּגּ֣וּל יִהְיֶ֑ה וְהַנֶּ֛פֶשׁ הָאֹכֶ֥לֶת מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עֲוֺנָ֥הּ תִּשָּֽׂא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im hê·’ā·ḵōl yê·’ā·ḵêl mib·bə·śar- ze·ḇaḥ šə·lā·māw bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî lō yê·rā·ṣeh ham·maq·rîḇ ’ō·ṯōw lō yê·ḥā·šêḇ lōw pig·gūl yih·yeh wə·han·ne·p̄eš hā·’ō·ḵe·leṯ mim·men·nū ‘ă·wō·nāh tiś·śā
verses.literal: If any of the meat from his peace offering is eaten on the third day it will not be accepted It will not be credited to the one who presented it it shall be an abomination and the one who eats of it shall bear his iniquity
verses.literalPt: Se alguma parte da carne do sacrifício das suas ofertas pacíficas for comida ao terceiro dia, o sacrifício não será aceito, nem será imputado àquele que o oferecer: será uma coisa abominável, e quem comer dela levará a sua iniquidade.

verses.original: וְהַבָּשָׂ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־ יִגַּ֤ע בְּכָל־ טָמֵא֙ לֹ֣א יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵ֑ף וְהַ֨בָּשָׂ֔ר כָּל־ טָה֖וֹר יֹאכַ֥ל בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hab·bā·śār ’ă·šer- yig·ga‘ bə·ḵāl ṭā·mê lō yê·’ā·ḵêl bā·’êš yiś·śā·rêp̄ wə·hab·bā·śār kāl- ṭā·hō·wr yō·ḵal bā·śār
verses.literal: Meat that touches anything unclean must not be eaten it is to be burned up As for any other meat anyone who is ceremonially clean may eat it
verses.literalPt: A carne que tocar alguma coisa imunda, não se comerá; será queimada com fogo. Quanto à carne, todo o que estiver limpo, comerá dela;

verses.original: וְהַנֶּ֜פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ תֹּאכַ֣ל בָּשָׂ֗ר מִזֶּ֤בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַיהוָ֔ה וְטֻמְאָת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·ne·p̄eš ’ă·šer- tō·ḵal bā·śār miz·ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm ’ă·šer Yah·weh wə·ṭum·’ā·ṯōw ‘ā·lāw wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w mê·‘am·me·hā
verses.literal: But if anyone who is unclean eats meat from the peace offering that belongs to the LORD . . . that person must be cut off from his people
verses.literalPt: mas a pessoa que, estando imunda, comer da carne do sacrifício de ofertas pacíficas, que pertence a Jeová, essa pessoa será exterminada do seu povo.

verses.original: וְנֶ֜פֶשׁ כִּֽי־ תִגַּ֣ע בְּכָל־ טָמֵ֗א בְּטֻמְאַ֤ת אָדָם֙ א֣וֹ׀ בִּבְהֵמָ֣ה טְמֵאָ֗ה א֚וֹ בְּכָל־ שֶׁ֣קֶץ טָמֵ֔א וְאָכַ֛ל מִבְּשַׂר־ זֶ֥בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַיהוָ֑ה וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ne·p̄eš kî- ṯig·ga‘ bə·ḵāl ṭā·mê bə·ṭum·’aṯ ’ā·ḏām ’ōw biḇ·hê·māh ṭə·mê·’āh ’ōw bə·ḵāl še·qeṣ ṭā·mê wə·’ā·ḵal mib·bə·śar- ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm ’ă·šer Yah·weh wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w mê·‘am·me·hā
verses.literal: If one touches anything unclean whether human uncleanness an unclean animal or any unclean detestable thing and then eats any of the meat of the peace offering that belongs to the LORD that person must be cut off from his people
verses.literalPt: Quando uma pessoa tocar alguma coisa imunda, ou seja imundícia de homem, ou seja animal imundo, ou seja alguma abominação imunda, e comer da carne do sacrifício de ofertas pacíficas, que pertence a Jeová, essa pessoa será exterminada do seu povo.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר כָּל־ חֵ֜לֶב שׁ֥וֹר וְכֶ֛שֶׂב וָעֵ֖ז לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr kāl- ḥê·leḇ šō·wr wə·ḵe·śeḇ wā·‘êz lō ṯō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and say You are not to eat any of the fat of an ox a sheep or a goat
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel: Não comereis gordura de boi, nem de ovelha, nem de cabra.

verses.original: וְחֵ֤לֶב נְבֵלָה֙ וְחֵ֣לֶב טְרֵפָ֔ה יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה לְכָל־ מְלָאכָ֑ה וְאָכֹ֖ל לֹ֥א תֹאכְלֻֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥê·leḇ nə·ḇê·lāh wə·ḥê·leḇ ṭə·rê·p̄āh yê·‘ā·śeh lə·ḵāl mə·lā·ḵāh wə·’ā·ḵōl lō ṯō·ḵə·lu·hū
verses.literal: The fat of an animal found dead . . . or mauled by wild beasts may be used for any other purpose but you must not eat it
verses.literalPt: A gordura do animal que morre por si mesmo, e a gordura do animal que é dilacerado por feras, pode-se usar para qualquer outro serviço; porém de maneira alguma comereis dela.

verses.original: כִּ֚י כָּל־ אֹכֵ֣ל חֵ֔לֶב מִן־ הַ֨בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֥יב מִמֶּ֛נָּה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הָאֹכֶ֖לֶת מֵֽעַמֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî kāl- ’ō·ḵêl ḥê·leḇ min- hab·bə·hê·māh ’ă·šer yaq·rîḇ mim·men·nāh ’iš·šeh Yah·weh wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh han·ne·p̄eš hā·’ō·ḵe·leṯ mê·‘am·me·hā
verses.literal: If anyone eats the fat of an animal from which a food offering may be presented to the LORD the one who eats it must be cut off from his people
verses.literalPt: Pois qualquer pessoa que comer da gordura do animal, do qual se oferecer uma oferta queimada a Jeová, sim, a pessoa que dela comer será exterminada do seu povo.

verses.original: וְכָל־ דָּם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכְל֔וּ בְּכֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶ֑ם לָע֖וֹף וְלַבְּהֵמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl dām lō ṯō·ḵə·lū bə·ḵōl mō·wō·šə·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem lā·‘ō·wp̄ wə·lab·bə·hê·māh
verses.literal: You must not eat the blood of any bird or animal in any of your dwellings
verses.literalPt: Não comereis sangue nem de aves, nem de gado, em alguma das vossas habitações.

verses.original: כָּל־ נֶ֖פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ תֹּאכַ֣ל כָּל־ דָּ֑ם וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵֽעַמֶּֽיהָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: kāl- ne·p̄eš ’ă·šer- tō·ḵal kāl- dām wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w mê·‘am·me·hā
verses.literal: If anyone . . . eats blood that person must be cut off from his people
verses.literalPt: Toda pessoa que comer sangue, essa será exterminada do seu povo.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר הַמַּקְרִ֞יב אֶת־ זֶ֤בַח שְׁלָמָיו֙ לַיהוָ֔ה יָבִ֧יא אֶת־ קָרְבָּנ֛וֹ לַיהוָ֖ה מִזֶּ֥בַח שְׁלָמָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr ham·maq·rîḇ ’eṯ- ze·ḇaḥ šə·lā·māw Yah·weh yā·ḇî ’eṯ- qā·rə·bā·nōw Yah·weh miz·ze·ḇaḥ šə·lā·māw
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and say Anyone who presents a peace offering to the LORD must bring it as his sacrifice . . . to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel: Quem oferecer o sacrifício das suas ofertas pacíficas a Jeová, trará a sua oblação a Jeová do sacrifício das suas ofertas pacíficas;

verses.original: יָדָ֣יו תְּבִיאֶ֔ינָה אֵ֖ת אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֶת־ הַחֵ֤לֶב עַל־ הֶֽחָזֶה֙ יְבִיאֶ֔נּוּ אֵ֣ת הֶחָזֶ֗ה לְהָנִ֥יף אֹת֛וֹ תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏāw tə·ḇî·’e·nāh ’êṯ ’iš·šê Yah·weh ’eṯ- ha·ḥê·leḇ ‘al- he·ḥā·zeh yə·ḇî·’en·nū ’êṯ he·ḥā·zeh lə·hā·nîp̄ ’ō·ṯōw tə·nū·p̄āh lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: With his own hands he is to bring the food offerings to the LORD he shall bring the fat together with the breast and wave the breast as a wave offering before the LORD
verses.literalPt: com as próprias mãos trará as ofertas queimadas, de Jeová; trará com o peito a gordura, para que o peito seja oferecido como uma oferta movida diante de Jeová.

verses.original: וְהִקְטִ֧יר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־ הַחֵ֖לֶב הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וְהָיָה֙ הֶֽחָזֶ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·ṭîr hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- ha·ḥê·leḇ ham·miz·bê·ḥāh wə·hā·yāh he·ḥā·zeh lə·’a·hă·rōn ū·lə·ḇā·nāw
verses.literal: The priest is to burn the fat on the altar but the breast belongs to Aaron and his sons
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote queimará a gordura sobre o altar; mas o peito pertencerá a Arão e a seus filhos.

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ שׁ֣וֹק הַיָּמִ֔ין תִּתְּנ֥וּ תְרוּמָ֖ה לַכֹּהֵ֑ן מִזִּבְחֵ֖י שַׁלְמֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ šō·wq hay·yā·mîn tit·tə·nū ṯə·rū·māh lak·kō·hên miz·ziḇ·ḥê šal·mê·ḵem
verses.literal: And you are to give the right thigh to the priest as a contribution from your peace offering
verses.literalPt: Dos sacrifícios de vossas ofertas pacíficas dareis a espádua direita ao sacerdote como oferta alçada.

verses.original: הַמַּקְרִ֞יב אֶת־ דַּ֧ם הַשְּׁלָמִ֛ים וְאֶת־ הַחֵ֖לֶב מִבְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן ל֧וֹ תִהְיֶ֛ה שׁ֥וֹק הַיָּמִ֖ין לְמָנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ham·maq·rîḇ ’eṯ- dam haš·šə·lā·mîm wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥê·leḇ mib·bə·nê ’a·hă·rōn lōw ṯih·yeh šō·wq hay·yā·mîn lə·mā·nāh
verses.literal: The son of Aaron who presents the blood and fat of the peace offering shall have the right thigh as a portion
verses.literalPt: Aquele que entre os filhos de Arão oferecer o sangue das ofertas pacíficas e a gordura, esse terá como sua porção a espádua direita.

verses.original: כִּי֩ אֶת־ חֲזֵ֨ה הַתְּנוּפָ֜ה וְאֵ֣ת׀ שׁ֣וֹק הַתְּרוּמָ֗ה לָקַ֙חְתִּי֙ מֵאֵ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִזִּבְחֵ֖י שַׁלְמֵיהֶ֑ם וָאֶתֵּ֣ן אֹ֠תָם לְאַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֤ן וּלְבָנָיו֙ לְחָק־ עוֹלָ֔ם מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’eṯ- ḥă·zêh hat·tə·nū·p̄āh wə·’êṯ šō·wq hat·tə·rū·māh lā·qaḥ·tî mê·’êṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl miz·ziḇ·ḥê šal·mê·hem wā·’et·tên ’ō·ṯām lə·’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên ū·lə·ḇā·nāw lə·ḥāq- ‘ō·w·lām mê·’êṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: I have taken from the sons of Israel the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution of their peace offerings and I have given them to Aaron the priest and his sons as a permanent . . . portion from the sons of Israel
verses.literalPt: Porque o peito movido e a espádua alçada tenho tomado dos filhos de Israel, dos sacrifícios das suas ofertas pacíficas, e os tenho dado a Arão, o sacerdote, e a seus filhos como uma coisa que lhes é devida para sempre pelos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: זֹ֣את מִשְׁחַ֤ת אַהֲרֹן֙ וּמִשְׁחַ֣ת בָּנָ֔יו מֵאִשֵּׁ֖י יְהוָ֑ה בְּיוֹם֙ הִקְרִ֣יב אֹתָ֔ם לְכַהֵ֖ן לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ miš·ḥaṯ ’a·hă·rōn ū·miš·ḥaṯ bā·nāw mê·’iš·šê Yah·weh bə·yō·wm hiq·rîḇ ’ō·ṯām lə·ḵa·hên Yah·weh
verses.literal: This is the portion of the food offerings to the LORD for Aaron and his sons since the day they were presented to serve the LORD as priests
verses.literalPt: Esta é a parte que a unção de Arão e seus filhos lhes dá das ofertas queimadas, de Jeová, desde o dia em que foram apresentados para exercerem as funções do sacerdócio a Jeová;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֗ם בְּיוֹם֙ מָשְׁח֣וֹ אֹתָ֔ם מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh lā·ṯêṯ lā·hem bə·yō·wm mā·šə·ḥōw ’ō·ṯām mê·’êṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām lə·ḏō·rō·ṯām
verses.literal: On the day they were anointed the LORD commanded that this be given them by the sons of Israel . . . It is a permanent portion for the generations to come
verses.literalPt: a qual Jeová ordenou que lhes dessem os filhos de Israel, no dia em que foram ungidos. É uma coisa que lhes é devida para sempre nas suas gerações.

verses.original: זֹ֣את הַתּוֹרָ֗ה לָֽעֹלָה֙ לַמִּנְחָ֔ה וְלַֽחַטָּ֖את וְלָאָשָׁ֑ם וְלַ֨מִּלּוּאִ֔ים וּלְזֶ֖בַח הַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ hat·tō·w·rāh lā·‘ō·lāh lam·min·ḥāh wə·la·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·lā·’ā·šām wə·lam·mil·lū·’îm ū·lə·ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm
verses.literal: This is the law of the burnt offering the grain offering the sin offering the guilt offering the ordination offering and the peace offering
verses.literalPt: Esta é a lei do holocausto, da oferta de cereais, da oferta pelo pecado, da oferta pela culpa, da consagração e do sacrifício de ofertas pacíficas,

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּהַ֣ר סִינָ֑י בְּי֨וֹם צַוֺּת֜וֹ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְהַקְרִ֧יב אֶת־ קָרְבְּנֵיהֶ֛ם לַיהוָ֖ה בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh bə·har sî·nāy bə·yō·wm ṣaw·wō·ṯōw ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lə·haq·rîḇ ’eṯ- qā·rə·bə·nê·hem Yah·weh bə·miḏ·bar sî·nāy
verses.literal: which the LORD gave Moses on Mount Sinai on the day He commanded the Israelites . . . to present their offerings to the LORD in the Wilderness of Sinai
verses.literalPt: a qual Jeová ordenou a Moisés no monte Sinai, no dia em que ordenou aos filhos de Israel que oferecessem as suas oblações a Jeová, no deserto de Sinai.
